verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows consent-based forwarding rules, such as not forwarding when a CCPA data-sale opt-out is present, and a bare title about transforming data as it leaves mParticle. Neither documents per-destination hashing, masking, or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes. Consent gating is an adjacent control, not PII transformation, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes
